%==================================================================
% Modern variant — header (DO NOT EDIT)
% Photo optional via \ShowPhoto{true} in config/personal.tex.
% Fields disabled with % in config/personal.tex are skipped, "|" auto-hides.
%==================================================================
\ifthenelse{\equal{\ShowPhoto}{true}}{%
  \noindent
  \begin{minipage}{0.22\textwidth}
    \IfFileExists{\photoPath}{%
      \includegraphics[width=\textwidth]{\photoPath}%
    }{%
      \fbox{\parbox[c][3cm][c]{\textwidth}{\centering\SmallFontSize photo\\ \photoPath}}
    }%
  \end{minipage}\hfill
  \begin{minipage}{0.74\textwidth}
    {\NameFontSize \cvName \par}
    \ifthenelse{\equal{\cvTagline}{}}{}{{\SmallFontSize \cvTagline \par}}\vspace{4pt}
    {\SmallFontSize
      \cvNeedSepfalse
      \ifthenelse{\equal{\cvLocation}{}}{}{\cvItem{\faMapMarker\ \cvLocation}}%
      \ifthenelse{\equal{\cvPhone}{}}{}{\cvItem{\faPhone\ \cvPhone}}%
      \ifthenelse{\equal{\cvEmail}{}}{}{\cvItem{\faEnvelope\ \href{mailto:\cvEmail}{\cvEmail}}}%
      \ifthenelse{\equal{\cvGithubUrl}{}\AND\equal{\cvLinkedinUrl}{}\AND\equal{\cvWebsiteUrl}{}}{}{%
        \ifcvNeedSep\\\cvNeedSepfalse\fi
        \ifthenelse{\equal{\cvGithubUrl}{}}{}{\cvItem{\faGithub\ \href{https://\cvGithubUrl}{\cvGithubLabel}}}%
        \ifthenelse{\equal{\cvLinkedinUrl}{}}{}{\cvItem{\faLinkedin\ \href{https://\cvLinkedinUrl}{\cvLinkedinLabel}}}%
        \ifthenelse{\equal{\cvWebsiteUrl}{}}{}{\cvItem{\faGlobe\ \href{https://\cvWebsiteUrl}{\cvWebsiteLabel}}}%
      }%
    \par}
  \end{minipage}\par\vspace{4pt}
}{%
  \begin{center}
    {\NameFontSize \cvName \par}
    \ifthenelse{\equal{\cvTagline}{}}{}{\vspace{2pt}{\SmallFontSize \cvTagline \par}}
    \vspace{2pt}
    {\SmallFontSize
      \cvNeedSepfalse
      \ifthenelse{\equal{\cvLocation}{}}{}{\cvItem{\faMapMarker\ \cvLocation}}%
      \ifthenelse{\equal{\cvPhone}{}}{}{\cvItem{\faPhone\ \cvPhone}}%
      \ifthenelse{\equal{\cvEmail}{}}{}{\cvItem{\faEnvelope\ \href{mailto:\cvEmail}{\cvEmail}}}%
      \ifthenelse{\equal{\cvGithubUrl}{}\AND\equal{\cvLinkedinUrl}{}\AND\equal{\cvWebsiteUrl}{}}{}{%
        \ifcvNeedSep\\\cvNeedSepfalse\fi
        \ifthenelse{\equal{\cvGithubUrl}{}}{}{\cvItem{\faGithub\ \href{https://\cvGithubUrl}{\cvGithubLabel}}}%
        \ifthenelse{\equal{\cvLinkedinUrl}{}}{}{\cvItem{\faLinkedin\ \href{https://\cvLinkedinUrl}{\cvLinkedinLabel}}}%
        \ifthenelse{\equal{\cvWebsiteUrl}{}}{}{\cvItem{\faGlobe\ \href{https://\cvWebsiteUrl}{\cvWebsiteLabel}}}%
      }%
    \par}
  \end{center}
  \vspace{-4pt}
}
